THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Gayantha Karunatilleke, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms, do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the land described below are neededfor a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions ofthat Act.

The Allotments of land depicted in the Advance Tracing No. GA/GFG/2019/391 of 08.07.2019 prepared by the Surveyor-General,situated in the Villages of Deddugoda South and Dangedara in theGrama Niladhari Divisions of Dangedara East, 97D and DeddugodaSouth, 101A in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Galle - FourGravets in the District of Galle in Southern Province and bounded asfollows:
01. Lot ‘A’ – Mahamoragodawatta – Extent: About 0.0015HectareNorth: Mahamoragodawatta claimed by D. P. Y. Gamage; Eastand South: Road; West: Mahamoragodawatta claimed by D. P. Y.Gamage.
02. Lot ‘B’ – Mahamoragodawatta – Extent: About 0.0014HectareNorth: Road; East: Mahamoragodawatta claimed by B. P. UdayaKasun; South and West: Road.

03. Lot ‘C’ – Mahamoragodawatta – Extent: About 0.0013HectareNorth: Road and the land acquired for Moragoda canal; East:Wellabagala Eladdara Ovita claimed by H. M. Dharmasena; South:Road and Lot D; West: Road.

04. Lot ‘D’ – Extent: About 0.0010 HectareNorth: Road and Lot C; East: Lot C, Wellabagala Eladdara Ovitaclaimed by H. M. Dharmasena and Road; South: Wellabagala EladdaraOvita claimed by unknown owner and Lot E; West: Road.

05. Lot ‘E’ – Kurunduwatta, Pashaul Ovita – Extent:About 0.0021 HectareNorth: Road and Lot D; East: Road and Wellabagala Ela AddaraOvita claimed by unknown owner; South: Wellabagala Ela AddaraOvita claimed by unknown owner; West: Road.

06. Lot ‘F’ – Kurunduwatta, Pashaul Ovita – Extent:About 0.0040 HectareNorth: Kurunduwatta, Pashaul Ovita claimed by Sajith Dayarathnaand land acquired for Moragoda canal; East: Road; South: Road andKurunduwatta, Pashaul Ovita claimed by unknown owner; West:Kurunduwatta, Pashaul Ovita claimed by Sajith Dayarathna.
Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
